pattern: がきっかけで / をきっかけに
aliases: ga kikkake de / o kikkake ni
purpose: Identify the event that started a lasting change.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N + がきっかけで / をきっかけに
A picture book sparked my interest in Japanese.
Moving house prompted me to start commuting by bicycle.
A friend’s introduction led me to this job.
formation: N + がきっかけで / をきっかけに
restrictions: The trigger starts a new activity, relationship, or direction.
mistake: Do not use it for every routine cause and result.
